conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: I’m freaking out! My loan payment is due, but I can’t access my account to pay it!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I’m here to help, ma’am. Can you confirm your loan account number?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s seven three, six six zero, one eight zero, nine one. What if I miss the payment? Will it hurt my credit?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: No need to worry. I can process a manual payment or extend the due date. Which works better?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Manual payment, please. I don’t want any trouble with my CIBIL score.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Done. The payment is processed, and your account is updated. You’re all set.
